label: Content Planning
description: Generates a keyword-driven content plan based on the client profile.

required_inputs.label: Target Keywords (comma-separated)
required_inputs.placeholder: seo services sydney, local seo, technical seo audit

prompt_template: You are an SEO strategist. Client profile: {{client_profile}}. Generate a structured content plan targeting the following keywords: {{inputs.targetKeywords}}. The plan should cover {{inputs.timeframeMonths}} months and include pillar pages, cluster articles, a publication schedule, and specific keyword targets for each piece.

keywordTargets.description: Primary keyword target for each content piece
